Ascertain | NYC (Hybrid) | Senior Product Engineer | Python, FastAPI, TypeScript

We’re building software to fix messy, real-world healthcare workflows—the kind that don’t fit neatly into SaaS.

This is a high-autonomy role for engineers who want ownership. You’ll work directly with customers, turn ambiguous problems into working systems, and ship end-to-end. We’re looking for someone who’s shipped real systems, is comfortable with ambiguity, and enjoys solving problems beyond the code.

$130K–$175K + equity + benefits

Apply: https://www.ascertain.com/careers?ashby_jid=b0c3a042-99a1-40...
